summary: Ultimate Oscillator: buying pressure over 7, 14 and 28 bars blended 4:2:1, from 0 to 100, with levels at 70 and 30.
overview: The Ultimate Oscillator, by Larry Williams, mixes three time spans into one line from 0 to 100 in its own pane. Levels sit at 70 and 30.
Using several windows helps reduce the false signals one window can give.
how: Buying pressure (BP) = close - min(low, previous close). True range (TR) = max(high, previous close) - min(low, previous close). For each window, average = sum of BP / sum of TR.
UO = 100 x (4 x avg7 + 2 x avg14 + avg28) / 7.
use: Some traders watch readings above 70 or below 30.
Look for divergence between UO and price, as in the original method.
Use the 50 line to separate up and down pressure.
Compare it with RSI to see how the blend changes signals.
alerts: Alerts: you can alert on its line crossing a value or the candle close (from the chart's + menu); checked while ZoroCharts is open.
notes: Works on any symbol and timeframe; it only needs candle data.
The fast window has the most weight.
Williams' original method also looked for a divergence followed by a break of the oscillator's recent high or low.
